subject: brand_state_permit
item: The brand holds a state tasting permit for the period.

subject: agency_staff_solicitor_permit
item: Our tasting staff need no permit of their own; the brand's permit covers them.

subject: store_tasting_permit
item: The store holds its own tasting permit.

subject: server_id_card
item: Each server carries a state identification card.

subject: advance_notice_filing
item: No advance notice of the event is filed with the division.

subject: sample_size_limit
item: Each sample stays within the size limit.

subject: store_owner_written_consent
item: The store owner's written consent is on file.

subject: tasting_log
item: A log of each tasting is kept.

subject: insurance_certificate_filed
item: A certificate of insurance is filed with the division.

subject: brand_representative_present
item: A brand representative is present at every tasting.

subject: age_verification
item: Every taster's age is verified before service.

subject: local_ordinance_review
item: The municipality's ordinance is reviewed for each store.

subject: signage_posted
item: No signage need be posted at the tasting table.

subject: permit_per_store
item: A separate permit is obtained for each store.

subject: post_event_report
item: No report is filed after the event.
